rationale:
OWNER RULING 2026-08-24. A tool built for a site is meant to gain CROSS-MENTIONS: one sentence woven into each related page's existing prose, mentioning the tool and linking to it (live example, dartsonline.com /blog/barrel-shapes.html: "…the tungsten percentage vs barrel diameter visualiser lets you compare percentages against weight…"). Which pages get one comes from `related_pages` on the add_tool work item.

That field has exactly ONE producer. [MEASURED 2026-08-24, add_tool items created since 08-17] tool-suggester 11 of 11 carry it; owner-request 0 of 58, automated_check 0 of 7, operator 0 of 1. Not a compliance rate — a clean split: the suggester's prompt asks for the field, and every other route writes the spec by hand from a five-key template that never had it. Until migration 516 (live 2026-08-21 16:55Z) the omission was masked by the whole-tree search substituting ANOTHER tool's list — that is bugs_open/330, nine tools on one site cross-linked to the same two articles. 516 removed the substitution, correctly, and the residue is that the omission now yields NOTHING, recorded only as an info row while the build succeeds and the page deploys. [MEASURED 2026-08-24] 13 of 13 tool births 08-22→08-24 emitted zero cross-links; tool-generator has created no tool_crosslink:% item since 08-21.

The owner was offered three options — do nothing, put the field in the hand-order recipe, or have the system ASK when it is absent — and chose the third with the second as a stopgap. The stopgap shipped already (d5dafd6a7, into the webdesign_tool_rebuilds runbook, which produces 58 of the 66 hand-filed items and is mid-programme at 33 of 63). This submission is the third.

The design constraint that shapes every edit: this must not become bugs_open/330 wearing a different hat. 330's defect was a SEARCH that silently returned another tool's answer. This is a DECLARED step with its own name, output field and prompt, asked about THIS tool, whose answer is a FALLBACK the requester always outranks, wired through a second OPTIONAL-EXPLICIT key so neither key can ever reach the whole-tree search again. Absence stays representable: the prompt states that an empty answer is a correct answer, and the migration's verify block refuses to commit if that sentence is ever edited out.

plan.summary: Two halves. The READER is committed and live-inert (0fb94a7dd): a second optional-explicit key, related_pages_fallback, consulted only when both spec paths are empty, plus a relatedPagesSource stamp ('spec'/'suggested') on every skip row and every emitted item so the change is measurable rather than inferred. The WIRE is migration 602, a _HOLD whose ordering condition is that binary being live. Sketches below are pasted from the committed files, not from memory (round-2 lesson, corr 642ecc3c).

edits.rationale: THE ORDER IS THE MEANING. The requester's pages win over the picker's, always — a picker that can overrule an explicit choice makes the field the requester filled in silently advisory, which is worse than no picker. Returning the SOURCE alongside is what makes the fix measurable: without it, a working picker and a week in which requesters happened to fill the field in are indistinguishable in every census.

Carry the source on the request struct and write it into both durable surfaces — the agent_error_log skip context and every emitted item's spec. Constants rather than literals because a typo in a string written into rows read back by census queries is invisible until someone counts.

Declare the key. An UNDECLARED key is dropped by ExtractActionInputs before the resolver sees it (bugs_closed/336's shape), so the picker would run, cost a model call and change nothing, invisibly. Optional-key budget after this edit: 5 of 10 (RFC_022, N=10).

The deployer carries the identical wire to the identical helper, and its own producer — the admin door at tool_admin_handlers.go:318 — builds a THREE-key spec, so it omits related_pages ALWAYS. Migration 516's scope section is the precedent and the argument: leaving one of two identical armed wires unmarked is how a class gets fixed and then rediscovered. Budget after: 4 of 10.

Drive the precedence through the REAL extractor with the live optional-explicit config rather than hand-built inputs, because an undeclared key never reaches the resolver and that is exactly how this class of fix silently does nothing. Plus a declaration guard over BOTH specs so the deployer half cannot be dropped later while every other test stays green. Mutation-proved in a git-archive-HEAD copy: reversing the precedence, deleting the fallback arm, and dropping the deployer declaration each fail exactly one test, with the message that names the defect.
edits.sketch:
TestRelatedPagesPrecedenceAndSource: 3 cases (requester wins / picker used and marked 'suggested' / absence stays absence)
TestBothToolActionsDeclareTheFallbackKey: both Optional sets must carry related_pages AND related_pages_fallback

edits.rationale: Two steps ahead of each saving step (load_site_pages → execute_llm_prompt) and one new wire. Both error_steps fall through TO the saving step, so a picker failure degrades to exactly today's behaviour and can never fail a tool build. NO conditional gate on the picker: bugs_open/313 is what that costs — an unresolvable condition silently evaluated false and skipped an agent's only LLM step on every run for four months while the run reported success. The price is one wasted model call on the ~14% of builds that already name pages; a wasted call is visible in llm_call_log, a skipped one is not. _HOLD because the reader must be live first: on a binary without the key the extractor drops it and the picker costs a call for nothing.

edits.rationale: Removes both steps, restores the direct next_step, drops the fallback wire, and ASSERTS that migration 516's related_pages? wire survived — a rollback that quietly took 516 with it would reopen bugs_open/330. Its own verify RAISEs, so a half-rollback aborts rather than committing a broken workflow.

grounded_in: MEASURED 2026-08-24: SELECT created_at::date, source, count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE spec ? 'related_pages') FROM site_work_items WHERE item_type='add_tool' AND created_at > '2026-08-16' GROUP BY 1,2 — tool-suggester 11/11, owner-request 0/58, automated_check 0/7, operator 0/1.

MEASURED 2026-08-24: tool births (content_components, component_level='tool') 08-22→08-24 = 13, and the skip codes account for all 13 with no remainder (8 no_related_pages, 5 tool_page_will_not_go_live). No tool_crosslink:% item created by tool-generator since 08-21.

Migration 516 applied 2026-08-21 16:55Z (lane NOTES; schema_migrations holds NO row for 516 — the runner refuses --record-only on a _HOLD sidecar — and '515%' returns 1 as a present-control). The first no_related_pages row of the new regime is 08-21 18:49Z.

Absence is instrumented, not silent, at create_tool_cross_link_items.go:143-151: 'Not a defect: a suggestion may legitimately name no related pages' — true of a suggester that chose none, false of an item no suggester saw, and the emitter cannot tell them apart. That asymmetry is what this change removes.
A wrong page name cannot become a wrong link: the emitter resolves every name against `pages` for that site and skips unmatched ones, and refuses any name beginning with 'tool-'.

Migration 602 was applied against the LIVE database inside a transaction and rolled back; its verify block passed, and the ROLLBACK file applied cleanly after it with 516 intact. Four induced mutations each ABORTED it with the intended message: fallback repointed, an unmarked twin added, prompt rule 5 removed, and error_step diverted away from the saving step.

Optional-key budget read fresh 2026-08-24 (scripts/audit-optional-key-budget.sh --json): create_tool_component 4 optional keys before this change, deploy_tool_to_site 3; budget N=10; 0 shared actions over it.
plan.risks:
1. The picker chooses a weak page. Bounded by prompt rule 4 (topical) and rule 5 (an empty answer is correct and preferred to a weak match), and by the fact that its answer is only ever consulted when the alternative is NOTHING. Detectable after the fact: every item and skip row now carries related_pages_source='suggested', so the picked ones can be audited as a set.

2. One wasted model call on builds whose spec already names pages (11 of 77 since 08-17). Accepted deliberately over a conditional gate — see the 602 edit's rationale and bugs_open/313.

3. Applying 602 before the reader is live costs a call per build and changes nothing, invisibly. That is why it is _HOLD, and the ordering block gives a binary probe with a present-control and an absent-control, plus the warning that -l app=agent-chassis matches 2 pods of the ~68 running this binary and tool-generator is a per-run pod, not one of the 2.

4. This does NOT backfill the ~30 tools already built without cross-mentions, and does not address bugs_open/379 (a regeneration that ADDS a related page never emits). Both are stated as out of scope rather than left to look covered.
